oracle.ref: PR #1438 (fix); fix evidence: Dev round tasks/evidence-wo-find-v2/dev-round.md (19/10/2026, dev 11749238ad): V4 Đà Nẵng 10 km Standard returned 38 places / 2 pages while the screen promised 60; Nha Trang 3 km returned 1 place because Nominatim's first row was the dissolved city boundary centred at sea; a reload within 3 s of a search queued no site checks
oracle.invariant: S1: search.depths names the limit a search really runs with (quick 20, standard 60 by default; lowered when the operator lowers gmapsMaxPlaces). S2: the place node's centre is used, not the historic boundary's. S3: the leading poll reads at once then every period; a plain poll waits one period; a hidden page skips the read but keeps the loop; a failed read does not stop it.
